checks.summary: Read the AMP three-layer curation and batch orchestrator skills plus the required source-review, quality-gate, rework-message, and two-queue packet contracts before judging acceptance.
Leader audit SHA-256 matches 40224ec73782d8f1eb6673cdaf3d74ccc941187354ae1e18700a47e444457a2d. Its PASS conclusion is supported by independent source, final, packet, runtime, and acceptance checks.

Primary XML/PDF identify PMCID PMC12837634, PMID 41594114, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics15010077, Antibiotics 2026, and title Cathelicidin-like Peptide for Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii Control. Source entities and sequence-not-reported boundary were independently checked.

The staged ZIP contains one one-page supplementary PDF. The packet has promoted PDF, rendered page, OCR/text, 38 supplementary locators, 24 S1 point observations, and no missing or unparsed staged supplement remains.

Independent XML Table 1 extraction matched all final table-derived rows: 12 MIC, 12 MBC, 8 MBIC activity rows plus 4 hemolytic concentration and 4 Raw 264.7 cytotoxicity rows. Endpoint, value, unit, target, and cell locators matched with no generic endpoints or sentence-fragment targets.

Body/PDF review supports the six non-table activity rows: BotrAMP14 time-kill at 4 min, CrotAMP14 time-kill at 20 min, and four approximate Figure 3 in vivo bacterial-load observations. Strain-label discordance is preserved rather than normalized.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage is source-supported: Table 1 hemolysis and Raw 264.7 IC50 rows, source-text BotrAMP14 hemolysis IC50 approximately 92 uM, and 24 approximate Supplementary Figure S1 percent-hemolysis points with approximate status and locators preserved.

All 42 fallback DBAASP machine rows are reviewed as unresolved_record; source_verified count is zero, candidate sequences are null, authoritative linked rows are absent, and authoritative ingest flags remain false. This is a preserved release-boundary caution, not a blocker.

Final mechanism ontology has 3 claims with evidence-strength semantics preserved: direct_mechanism=0, phenotype_supported=1, inferred_mechanism=2. Prior-literature SEM/membrane language is not promoted to a current-paper direct mechanism.

Paper and packet final mirrors are byte-identical for activity, database, materials, mechanism, and review. Packet-only mechanism_evidence is an alias of mechanism_ontology_record. Final counts are activity=38, toxicity=33, database=42, mechanism=3; locator index has 170 locators including 38 supplementary locators.

Rework surface has 10 requests, 21 responses, and 10 closure receipts. All request IDs have closure receipts; live analysis_status and review_report both report zero open tickets and zero rework targets.

run_sequence_latest has six canonical workers worker-1 through worker-6, six unique Codex session IDs, all codex exec, returncode 0, model gpt-5.5, reasoning_effort xhigh. Worker-6 started at 2026-07-27T21:29:36Z after latest upstream finish at 2026-07-27T21:29:34Z.

Current single-paper strict acceptance audit and gate reports pass: packet gate returncode 0 with no hard findings or open tickets, semantic gate publication_grade_pass true with zero issues, and publication-quality pass true without allow flags.

Recursive authority is false: fallback machine rows remain candidate-only, source_verified=0, authoritative_ingest_ready=false, authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false. Strict acceptance explicitly limits this to paper-level source-reviewed evidence, not authoritative DBAASP/portal/RC2 ingest.

Parsed 169 JSON and 14 JSONL current work/final/packet files. One old zero-byte diagnostic_semantic_gate.json is invalid JSON, but it is not on the terminal acceptance path; later live semantic, publication, packet, final, and acceptance gate artifacts are valid and passing.
